---
name: Architecture change
about: A larger design discussion before code (read this first for big PRs)
title: 'arch: '
labels: architecture, discussion
assignees: ''
---

**Context**
What problem are you trying to solve? Who is the user?

**Current behaviour**
What does the system do today? Reference specific files.

**Proposed change**
A 1-2 paragraph sketch of the new design. NOT a PR yet — we want to
agree on the design first.

**What you've considered + ruled out**
List 2-3 alternative designs you thought about and why they don't fit.

**Effort estimate**
- [ ] Small (≤ 200 LOC, 1 file)
- [ ] Medium (a subsystem refactor)
- [ ] Large (cross-cutting; needs ADR)

**Are you offering to implement?**
- [ ] Yes (PR will follow this design discussion)
- [ ] No, just proposing
